chapters.label: Four-nil, live
chapters.text: Rosario, World Cup 1978. Argentina must beat Peru by four goals to reach the final. It's three-nil. Captain Daniel Passarella, a defender, races into the box. The ball flies in. Passarella heads it on, and Leopoldo Luque dives... Four-nil!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. Passarella wasn't tall, but he scored many headers. He times his run, jumps high, eyes on the ball. Header! Luque's diving header does the rest.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Defenders can score too! At corners and free kicks, run into the box and attack the ball with a strong header.
